name: integrable_sum_dirac_iff
statement: ∀ i, c i ≠ ∞) : Integrable f (Measure.sum (fun i ↦ (c i) • .dirac (x i))) ↔ Summable (fun i ↦ (c i).toReal * ‖f (x i)‖) where mp h

have_tree.name: hmem
have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ∂Measure.sum μ), (∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ∂Measure.sum μ) < y + ε

name: setIntegral_countable
statement: X → E) {s : Set X} (hs : s.Countable) (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) : ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ = ∑' x : s, μ.real {(x : X)} • f x
